{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, using available data
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print results for verification
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f'Highest species: {highest_species}')"}
